tools.name: search_agencies
tools.description: Search 960+ evidence-checked AI automation, internal-tools and AI-app agencies on Cofounderbase by a plain-English need. Optional filters: city, country, service, tool (e.g. n8n, Make, Zapier, Retool, Vapi), max starting budget in USD and verified_only. Returns ranked agencies with a reason for each

tools.name: match_agencies
tools.description: Describe a project and get exactly the 5 best-fit agencies, each with a one-line reason. Verified agencies receive a ranking boost in this tool. Optional budget (USD) and location (city or country).

tools.name: get_agency
tools.description: Public Cofounderbase profile for one agency by slug (from search results): description, location, Verified flag, tools, use cases, industries, services, published prices, case studies, partner certifications and score. No contact details.

tools.name: top_agencies
tools.description: Highest-scored agencies on Cofounderbase for a use case (e.g. "Voice agents", "Chatbots", "RAG/knowledge base", "CRM automation/sync"), a tool (e.g. "n8n") and/or a country.

tools.name: request_intro
tools.description: Ask Cofounderbase to introduce the user to up to 5 agencies. Only call this when the user explicitly asks for an introduction and gives their own name and email. Required: requester_name, requester_email, project_brief (min 10 characters) and agency_slug or agency_slugs (legacy name/email/brief also

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_agencies" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
